set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Guides contain runnable balanced and unbalanced OT examples.
- Decision table maps data assumptions to formulations.
- Examples inspect convergence and perform barycentric projection.
- GW examples explain relation to linear OT.
- All code runs in clean vignette builds and is linked from README/site.
set.title: Publish task-oriented linear OT and GW integration guides
